name: Wordloom
summary: A work desk for a small translation studio: job loom, deadlines by translator, term base, invoicing
about: A complete work desk for a small translation or writing studio, shown with a made-up six-person team, eight clients and thirty jobs across many language pairs. Live jobs are threads on a loom woven as far as the words are done, deadlines sit on a strip you can drag between days and translators, and a term base keeps client wording consistent. Good for translation agencies, copywriting studios, subtitle teams and freelancer collectives.
how: Desk shows the loom: each live job is a thread woven up to its progress. Hover a thread for details, click it to open the job. A live counter tracks words written today.
On Jobs, search and filter every job, then start it, log words or deliver it from its row. Logging the last words sends a job to review.
On Deadlines, drag a job dot to another day or translator. Red shading warns when someone has more words than days. Arrow keys move a focused dot.
Open a job for its segment bar, translator, reviewer, due date, files and comments.
Term base lists the words to use and the words to avoid per client. Approve new terms with one click.
Team sets languages, daily capacity and time off. Clients shows rates and sends an invoice for delivered jobs. Settings has the minimum fee, theme and Reset demo data.
